mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, o.member_id AS memberId, m.real_name AS memberName, m.mobile AS memberMobile, o.order_type AS orderType, o.order_source AS orderSource, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.payable_amount AS payableAmount, o.paid_amount AS paidAmount, o.paid_time AS paidTime, o.trade_no AS tradeNo, o.cashier_user_id AS cashierUserId, o.remark AS remark, o.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC

FROM fit_order o LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = o.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT item_id AS itemId, item_no AS itemNo, item_type AS itemType,
item_ref_id AS itemRefId, item_name AS itemName, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice, discount_amount AS discountAmount, real_amount AS realAmount, grant_card_id AS grantCardId FROM fit_order_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY item_id ASC
